about_short_description.short_description: BrioHR is an all-in-one, affordable, modular, and simple cloud-based HR management software with complementary mobile app.

product.name: Payroll Software
product.description: Automates payroll setup, manages multi-cycle payroll, securely stores payroll data, and prepares payroll reports.

product.name: Performance Management
product.description: Streamlines performance evaluations with real-time monitoring, custom appraisal forms, and 360° feedback.

product.name: Recruitment & Applicant Tracking System
product.description: Manages job openings, candidate screening, and interview processes with integrated dashboards and custom notifications.

product.name: Employee Onboarding
product.description: Facilitates onboarding with custom tracks, automated reminders, and integration with payroll.

product.name: Expense Claims
product.description: Manages expense claims with custom approval workflows, automated notifications, and integration with payroll and accounting.

product.name: Timesheets
product.description: Tracks and analyzes time spent on projects, with custom reporting and integration with other BrioHR modules.
